title.value: Solving ODE with Universal Flows: Approximation Theory for Flow-Based Models
title.justification: The title is directly mentioned at the beginning of the paper, and it aptly describes the core focus of the research, which is on solving ordinary differential equations using universal flows and their application to flow-based models.
title.quote: S OLVING ODE WITH U NIVERSAL F LOWS : A PPROXIMATION T HEORY FOR F LOW -B ASED M ODELS

analysis.description: The paper introduces a novel approach to using ordinary differential equations (ODEs) as a framework for establishing universal approximation theory in flow-based models, particularly in the context of normalizing flows. It explores the universality and expressiveness of flow-based models using ODEs and provides theoretical grounding through approximation theories.

type.justification: The paper primarily focuses on theoretical aspects such as providing a mathematical framework for flow-based models using ODEs, establishing universal approximation theorems, and giving proofs to support these theories.
type.quote: In this work, we propose to use ODEs as a framework to establish universal approximation theory for certain families of flow-based models.
